description: This Java source file defines the EventStepDef class, which contains Cucumber step definitions for verifying event-related behaviors in Fineract's test framework. It uses reflection and classpath scanning to resolve event types based on string identifiers, and asserts the presence or absence of specific events tied to loan operations.

classes.name: EventStepDef
classes.description: A step definition class for Cucumber tests, handling event assertion steps related to loans, utilizing classpath scanning to dynamically resolve event classes.

methods.name: assertEventRaisedForLoan
methods.description: Verifies that a specific event has been raised for a loan, given an event type as string.

methods.name: assertEventNotRaisedForLoan
methods.description: Verifies that a specific event has not been raised for a loan, given an event type as string.

methods.name: resolveEventType
methods.description: Resolves an event type string to its corresponding Class object by scanning the classpath for matching class names.
